Hi Sarah — I'd like to get next week's CSE455 staff meeting on the calendar. Looking at my week, the free windows I have are:

- Mon 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30

Which of those work for you? If none do, tell me what you have open and I'll see what I can do.

Hello — Professor Alvarez here. I'm putting next week's CSE455 staff meeting on my calendar, in my free time. Could you confirm the official schedule for next week, in particular that nothing official (lecture, seminar, committee, department meeting) is scheduled in these windows on my calendar:

- Mon 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30

Thank you.

Hello Professor Alvarez — here is the official schedule for next week, for the windows you listed:

- **Mon 10:00-10:30** — free, no official event.
- **Mon 14:00-14:30** — **taken**: Seminar, Mon 14:10-15:40.
- **Tue 11:00-11:30** — **taken**: Seminar, Tue 09:50-11:10 (overlaps to 11:10).
- **Tue 15:00-15:30** — free; CSE452 lecture ends at 15:00 and CSE455 office hours start at 15:30.
- **Wed 10:00-10:30** — free; CSE455 office hours start at 10:30.
- **Wed 13:00-13:30** — free; the quiz section and guest lecture prep both start at 13:30.

So three of the six windows are clear for your staff meeting: Mon 10:00-10:30, Tue 15:00-15:30 and Wed 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30. A staff meeting goes into your free time, so please keep it out of the two windows above. Nothing official next week is cancelled or moved.
Thank you — that's clear. I'll keep the staff meeting to Mon 10:00-10:30, Tue 15:00-15:30 or Wed 10:00-10:30 / 13:00-13:30.

Hi Professor Alvarez — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 works for me; I've put the CSE455 staff meeting on my calendar then. My other open windows next week, if you'd rather move it: Mon 11:50-13:10, Tue 11:10-12:10, Wed 12:00-13:00, Thu 12:00-12:50, Fri 11:00-12:20.
Wednesday 10:00-10:30 it is — the department confirms that window is clear, so consider the CSE455 staff meeting booked. I've put it on my calendar and logged it. Thanks, Sarah.
Thanks — logged on my side too. See you Wednesday 10:00.
